sentences: Mechanism implementation connects an allocation algorithm with strategic behavior that makes its intended outcome attainable.
The textbook asks whether efficient algorithmic implementation can approximate better than every efficient dominant-strategy implementation.
Dominant strategies require honest behavior to be optimal regardless of others' reports, imposing a particularly strong incentive condition.
A separation would quantify the algorithmic value of a weaker implementation framework.
The saved historical note does not define that framework or choose the optimization objective, so the proposed comparison needs those details before it becomes one concrete approximation separation.
